title: Snyderville Basin General Plan
jurisdiction: Snyderville Basin Planning District (unincorporated western Summit County)
notes: Adopted by Ordinance 839 on 2015-06-17. The Basin's long-range growth/land-use framework; the Basin implements INCLUSIONARY ZONING (20% affordable set-aside) via the Snyderville Basin Development Code (Title 10). Comprehensive update in progress (2024-25 visioning; no adopted new plan yet). Born-digital, 94 pp, 14.2 MB retained.

title: Eastern Summit County General Plan

notes: Base plan 2013; amended 2023-08-13. Governing plan for the East Side; being harmonized with the Basin plan via a joint General Plan committee (2024). Born-digital, 18 pp, 435 KB.
